about: The backtest table of IMPROVEMENT_PLAN §1.4 S2 as data. Each new check must FAIL on the state a critic failed and PASS on the fix. kind 'fixture': {fixture} is replaced by the variant's file. kind 'commit-pair': the runner checks out each commit in a temporary git worktree, {root} is replaced by its path (and MQ_ROOT is set to it), and the check script is always the CURRENT tree's. browser: true rows run through /tmp/mq-browser-run.sh. pending: true rows have no command yet and report PENDING, never OK. Run: node tests/scripts/ws-backtest.mjs
